column8: Live COM_QUERY INNER rows exercise equality plus a cross-side greater-than residual and TRUE-only materialization; both physical build orientations, typed key layouts, selected chunks, and 200-row probe batches remain open.
Join materialization and tri-state conditions are executable through COM_QUERY; the full physical joiner file including memory disk and chunk lifecycle is not ported.
Residual conditions produce every expected result row without a staging chunk; exact InitChunkSize allocation and clone capacity are not represented by the row-vector executor.
Result rows are materialized in source order; Go Chunk.SetRequiredRows early-fill behavior across the type matrix is not represented.
Live LEFT join covers TRUE FALSE and UNKNOWN residual candidates with null extension; hash build orientation, selected input chunks, and 200-row batching remain open.

TRUE and UNKNOWN masks plus reusable buffers are preserved and the live join consumes the scalar-equivalent path; vectorized kernels, every Go eval type, random selection slices, and row/vector equivalence remain open.

Live COM_QUERY NullEq matches NULL to NULL and non-NULL equals through the same bound equality evaluator; cascades plan-tree shape, INTERSECT semi join, derived nested join plan selection, and null-aware anti joins remain open.
Residual bindings preserve source order and FullSchema indexes needed by lookup filters; range building, index offsets, compare-filter manager, accesses and remained outputs remain open.

Direct and USING-qualified projection metadata consumes visible and FullSchema fields without collapsing redundant sides; derived/UNION planner schema production, optimizer projection elimination, and exact NotNull propagation remain open.
